description: A short check for HR and recruitment staff at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional company, taken before the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten emails from the Tarrowby recruitment inbox: applications, CVs and messages from colleagues and agencies. The result is kept so the matching after-check (awareness_post_hr_ba) can show how the two compare. Organiser note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
